request.raw_text: Change that vertical slot to cut through complete body to decrease weight

areas_to_change.action: Modify the existing slot cut to use a through-all extent.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The vertical rounded-end slot in the lower upright curved support.
areas_to_change.location: On the narrow upright rib below the curved transition and above the base plate, visible on the side faces in the +Z and -Z views.
areas_to_change.description: Extend the existing vertical slot through the complete local thickness of the upright body while retaining its current profile, position, and orientation.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the slot's current height, width, rounded ends, vertical orientation, and center location; change only its cut depth.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Base mounting plate and its two mounting holes
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep all dimensions, positions, edge rounds, and through-hole geometry unchanged.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Central open hook or fork profile
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing opening, angled surfaces, curved boundaries, and clearances.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Upper rectangular housing and top threaded boss
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the housing envelope, fillets, top boss, threaded bore, and transverse side hole.
Preserve the exterior curved transition, wall profile, and base fillets except where intersected by the through slot.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The existing rounded vertical slot becomes an open through-slot spanning the full thickness of the upright rib and is visible as an opening from both opposing side faces.
predicted_final_outcome.function: Removes additional material from the upright support without changing the mounting or interface geometry.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The component will have reduced mass while retaining the same external envelope and mounting relationships, with some local reduction in stiffness and strength around the slot.

ambiguities.description: The request does not explicitly state the cutting direction, but the existing slot indicates that it should pass through the local thickness normal to its visible side face.
candidate_interpretations: Extend the existing slot through the entire local thickness of the upright rib.
Extend the slot through every intersected solid region along its current cut direction.
